prompt: What's on my calendar tomorrow, and did Dana email about the budget? Find the budget spreadsheet in my Drive, then draft a reply to Dana saying I'll bring it to the meeting, with a link to the sheet. Don't send it.

input.command: tools list calendar --schema; tools list mail --schema; tools list drive --schema; date

tools call mail.draft --json - <<'J'
{"reply_to":"msg_20c371b4963e4493","to":["dana@example.test"],"subject":"Re: Q3 budget numbers","body":"Hi Dana,

Thanks for the note. I'll bring the latest budget sheet to the meeting. Here's the link: https://docs.example.test/spreadsheets/d/f-budget

See you there,
Sam"}
J
